prompt: Which country was the first outside of Africa to detect a case of mpox in the most recent outbreak? Note that the first human cases were diagnosed in 1970.
answer: Sweden was the first country outside Africa to detect a case in the recent mpox outbreak. It confirmed a clade Ib case on **15 August 2024** in a traveler returning from an affected African country.
